action.command: cd /workspace && echo "=== browser-like load of MainPage dependency graph via vite transform ==="; curl -s "http://127.0.0.1:5173/resources/js/pages/MainPage.vue" -o /tmp/mp.js -w "MainPage.vue HTTP %{http_code}\n"; grep -oE 'from "[^"]*"' /tmp/mp.js | head -20; echo "=== fetch each resolved import ==="; grep -oE '"[^"]*\.(vue|js|ts)"' /tmp/mp.js | tr -d '"' | sort -u | while read p; do rc=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "http://127.0.0.1:5173$p"); echo "$p => $rc"; done

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace && echo \"=== browser-like load of MainPage dependency graph via vite transform ===\"; curl -s \"http://127.0.0.1:5173/resources/js/pages/MainPage.vue\" -o /tmp/mp.js -w \"MainPage.vue HTTP %{http_code}\\n\"; grep -oE 'from \"[^\"]*\"' /tmp/mp.js | head -20; echo \"=== fetch each resolved import ===\"; grep -oE '\"[^\"]*\\.(vue|js|ts)\"' /tmp/mp.js | tr -d '\"' | sort -u | while read p; do rc=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w \"%{http_code}\" \"http://127.0.0.1:5173$p\"); echo \"$p => $rc\"; done", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Load MainPage transitive dependency graph"}
